article.title: Ecuador Pushes to Expand Amazon Oil Drilling While Land Defenders Face Threats
article.content: Ecuadorians voted overwhelmingly in 2023 to stop oil extraction at Yasuní National Park, one of the most biodiverse places on Earth, yet oil drilling has continued despite that historic referendum. “The government does not want to close the wells,” says Ivonne Yánez, the president of Acción Ecológica, an environmental nonprofit group based in Ecuador. The Ecuadorian government is also “continuing expanding the oil activities in the Amazon,” she points out. Yánez also speaks about how dangerous Latin America is for environmental activists. It is where “the most number of defenders that are just defending their lands, their rivers, their rights,” are killed. “And in Ecuador, this is also happening.”
